title: Your Ad Is On-Brand. Is It On-Tone?
summary: Tone of voice can make or break a CTV ad. Learn what messaging converts and how to match your ad’s tone to your KPI.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


5


Quick Takeaways


How your ad sounds can shape whether viewers visit or buy.


1. 1


Positive or neutral tone outperformed negative tone on both site visit rate and conversion rate in QuickFrame and MNTN’s study.


2. 2


Fear-led ads had a 49% higher site visit rate but a 55% lower conversion rate than the study average.


3. 3


Pleasant ads can leave lasting positive brand associations, especially for products people buy for enjoyment.


4. 4


Treat these findings as patterns to test: advertiser category, surrounding ads, and sound can all influence the response.


5. 5


Test a new opening line, voiceover, or re-edit before changing budget, and match the tone to your campaign goal.
